prompt: Which fields in the Basic Information section are read-only and cannot be changed from the profile page?
choices: First name and last name
Phone number and role
Email address and role
First name and email address

prompt: After clicking Edit Profile, which fields become editable?
choices: Email and role
Name and phone number
Role and branch assignment
All fields including email and role

prompt: What does the Save button validate before committing your profile changes?
choices: That your email matches your hospital domain
That your role is set correctly by the administrator
Names must contain letters only, and phone numbers must be a valid format
That your phone number matches the branch directory

prompt: On the support submission form, what is pre-filled and locked automatically?
choices: Subject line and description
Priority and affected modules
Full name and work email
Feedback type and priority level

prompt: What does the Type of Feedback field help the support team do?
choices: Assess the urgency of your request
Route your ticket to the correct team immediately
Pre-fill the subject line with the right category
Determine which modules are affected

prompt: When should you set Priority to Critical on a support ticket?
choices: For any bug that affects your personal workflow
Whenever the issue involves a cryotank reading
When the issue is actively impacting patient safety or live operations
For all Feature Requests to ensure faster review

prompt: What do you receive immediately after submitting a support ticket?
choices: An email with the full ticket details
A confirmation page showing your ticket ID
A phone call from the support team within the hour
A redirect to the Activity Logs report

prompt: What are the three stages a support ticket moves through?
choices: Submitted → Reviewed → Closed
Pending → Active → Resolved
New → Assigned → Completed
Open → In Review → Resolved

prompt: What does clicking a row in the Support Activity table let you do?
choices: Re-submit the ticket with updated details
Delete the ticket from your history
Open the full ticket to read the description, view support comments, and add follow-up notes
Escalate the ticket to Critical priority

prompt: What does the Ticket Update Emails toggle in Notifications do?
choices: Sends you a weekly summary of all open tickets
Emails you whenever one of your support ticket statuses changes
Notifies the support team when you add a comment
Enables SMS alerts for Critical priority tickets
